description: Parent account of the store, created through the account API with the store context, optionally with a Sales Rep and the two Sales Rep flags. Outputs: accountId, accountName, accountCode, salesRepUserId. Created per test, deleted at teardown. Story Z10-38546.

store.description: Store code the account belongs to (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

rep.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account's Sales Rep: link it to the test's sales rep (@rep.userId), a rep of the same store. Left out: no Sales Rep

enableSalesRepInheritance.description: Additional attribute Enable Sales Rep Inheritance (child accounts created later inherit the rep). Left out: the default, No

applySalesRepChangesToAllUsers.description: Additional attribute Apply Sales Rep Changes to All Users (rep changes also overwrite user overrides). Left out: the default, No
